title: Fire, Gardens, and the Call to Hajj

paragraphs.text: In Hell, boiling water will melt the disbelievers' insides and skins. Iron rods will strike them. Each time they try to escape in pain, they will be pushed back. But the believers who do good will enter gardens with rivers. They will wear bracelets of gold and pearls and clothes of silk. They were guided to good words and to the path of the Praiseworthy.

Some disbelievers block people from Allah's way and from al-Masjid al-Haram. This mosque is for all people, those who live near it and visitors. Whoever plans wrong there will taste painful punishment.

Allah showed Abraham the place of the House. He told him to associate nothing with Allah and to purify the House for those who walk around it and pray. Abraham was told to call people to Hajj. They would come on foot and on thin camels from far away. They would mention Allah's name over the animals He gave them, eat, and feed the poor. Then they should keep their vows and walk around the ancient House. Honoring Allah's symbols comes from piety of the heart. People must avoid idols and false speech. Whoever associates others with Allah is like someone falling from the sky.

Allah gave every nation a rite of sacrifice. Give good news to the humble, who fear Allah, stay patient, pray and spend. Camels and cattle are among Allah's symbols, so eat from them and feed the needy.

hardWords.m: fear and love of Allah shown in life
